description.value: Bonjour Banh Mi is a Vietnamese sandwich shop on Cambie Street specializing in banh mi made with house-baked bread and in-house sauces prepared fresh daily. The concise menu spans signature cold cut subs, grilled pork and lemongrass chicken banh mi, salad rolls, rice and vermicelli bowls, and soup — offering quick, filling meals well-suited to cyclists passing through South Vancouver. Vegetarian choices appear across multiple menu categories.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 10m; rack (2 spaces) at 40m; rack at 46m; rack (4 spaces) at 68m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and corroborates the OSM address (5556 Cambie Street, Vancouver, BC V5Z 3A2) and business name. The contact page reveals a phone number absent from OSM. The menu explicitly lists vegetarian options; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number (778) 895-5556 found on website contact page and added to listing.
Website page title renders as 'Bonjour Banh Mi Van' but footer and address block consistently use 'Bonjour Banh Mi', matching OSM — OSM name treated as authoritative.
OSM address lacks province and postal code; website provides full address 'Vancouver, BC V5Z 3A2', used here.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational restaurant with an active website, confirmed address, and full menu — a practical food stop for cyclists on the Cambie Street corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu item #4 Veggie / Chay (veggie pate, veggie ham, jicama) and item #10 Veggie Salad Rolls (carrots, jicama, lettuce, vermicelli, rice paper) confirm vegetarian options

wow_evidence: house-baked bread and in-house sauces prepared fresh daily
